source_row.stem: A healthcare worker with a significant, high-risk exposure to a highly contagious pathogen may be furloughed (excluded from work) during the incubation period. This practice is intended to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Serving mainly to punish the exposed worker rather than to protect clients and colleagues from potential spread","B":"Applied the same way regardless of how high-risk the specific exposure is considered to have been","C":"Carrying no real infection control rationale behind the decision to exclude the worker temporarily","D":"Prevent potential transmission to clients and other staff if the worker develops the infection"}}
source_row.rationale: Furlough (work exclusion) during the incubation period for a high-risk exposure to a highly contagious pathogen is intended to prevent potential transmission to clients and staff if the exposed worker develops the infection.
